messages.content: Define a federated learning task contract for a synthetic cohort of 5 clients. Specify the model type (e.g., linear regression), the global objective, the per-client data partition sizes, eligibility criteria, privacy budget (e.g., epsilon), and the threat model including a possible poisoning adversary. Record this contract as the authoritative task input for the round.

I'll build this as a proper, machine-readable task contract: a declared synthetic cohort of 5 clients, an eligibility audit that determines the effective cohort, the FedAvg optimization objective with aggregation weights, a DP budget with per-round accounting, a poisoning-aware threat model, and a tamper-evident record (canonical SHA-256) that fixes the contract as the authoritative round input.

```python
import json, hashlib, math
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ROUND_ID  = "FL-LINREG-ROUND-0001"
ISSUED_AT = "2026-10-12T00:00:00Z"
SEED      = 20261012
FEATURE_DIM = 24

# ======================================================================
# 1. SYNTHETIC COHORT ROSTER — 5 candidate clients (declared / fixed)
# ======================================================================
roster = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(client_id="C1", site="north_general_hospital", n_samples=14000, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.004, target_coverage=0.98, uptime=0.997, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=12.4, shift_note="reference distribution"),
 dict(client_id="C2", site="lakeside_clinic", n_samples=9000, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.011, target_coverage=0.93, uptime=0.988, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=18.7, shift_note="mild label shift (younger cohort)"),
 dict(client_id="C3", site="regional_lab", n_samples=11500, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.006, target_coverage=0.95, uptime=0.994, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=15.2, shift_note="covariate shift (assay platform B)"),
 dict(client_id="C4", site="rural_health_post", n_samples=6500, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.018, target_coverage=0.86, uptime=0.962, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=41.3, shift_note="heteroskedastic target, long tail"),
 dict(client_id="C5", site="mobile_screening_unit", n_samples=4000, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.031, target_coverage=0.74, uptime=0.905, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=63.8, shift_note="instrument drift, incomplete target range"),
])

# ======================================================================
# 2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA (pre-registered gates, evaluated at admission)
# ======================================================================
criteria = {
 "min_samples":            dict(op=">=", threshold=5000,  field="n_samples"),
 "max_missing_rate":       dict(op="<=", threshold=0.02,  field="missing_rate"),
 "min_target_coverage":    dict(op=">=", threshold=0.80,  field="target_coverage"),
 "min_uptime":             dict(op=">=", threshold=0.95,  field="uptime"),
 "max_grad_norm_p95":      dict(op="<=", threshold=50.0,  field="grad_norm_p95"),
 "max_cross_client_dupes": dict(op="<=", threshold=0.000, field="dup_overlap"),
 "feature_schema_match":   dict(op="==", threshold=FEATURE_DIM, field="feature_dim"),
}
OPS = {">=": lambda a, b: a >= b, "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b, "==": lambda a, b: a == b}

audit = roster.copy()
gates = pd.DataFrame(index=roster.index)
for name, c in criteria.items():
    gates[name] = OPS[c["op"]](roster[c["field"]], c["threshold"])
audit["n_failed"] = (~gates).sum(axis=1)
audit["eligible"] = audit["n_failed"] == 0
audit["failed_gates"] = [",".join(gates.columns[~gates.loc[i]].tolist()) or "-" for i in gates.index]

eligible = roster.loc[audit["eligible"]].copy()
excluded = roster.loc[~audit["eligible"]].copy()
n_eligible, N_eligible = len(eligible), int(eligible["n_samples"].sum())
eligible["weight"] = eligible["n_samples"] / N_eligible        # FedAvg aggregation weight

# ======================================================================
# 3. GLOBAL OBJECTIVE (weighted empirical risk, ridge-penalised)
# ======================================================================
lambda_ridge, rounds_T, lr, local_epochs, batch = 1e-4, 50, 0.05, 3, 256
objective = {
 "model_type": "linear_regression (FedAvg / FedSGD-to-FedAvg, local Adam-free SGD + momentum 0.9)",
 "parameters": {"w_bias_init": "zeros", "d": FEATURE_DIM},
 "local_objective": "F_k(w) = (1/n_k) * SUM_i (w^T x_i - y_i)^2",
 "global_objective": "min_w F(w) = SUM_k (n_k / N) * F_k(w) + (lambda/2) * ||w||^2  [data-weighted, not uniform]",
 "loss": "mean squared error (target: optimisation); primary metric: RMSE on held-out global test set",
 "lambda_ridge": lambda_ridge,
 "rounds": rounds_T,
 "local_epochs": local_epochs,
 "local_batch_size": batch,
 "client_optimizer": "SGD(momentum=0.9, lr=0.05)",
 "server_optimizer": "weighted aggregation only (no server-side learning rate)",
 "init": "common random init, seed pinned to 20261012, broadcast by server",
 "acceptance_test": {"metric": "global_RMSE", "threshold": "<= 1.05 x centralised_ridge_5fold_CV_RMSE",
                     "secondary": "per-client RMSE gap <= 15% relative to its own local-only baseline"},
 "convergence_stop": "PATIENCE=8 rounds on global val RMSE, or T=50, whichever first",
}

# ======================================================================
# 4. PER-CLIENT DATA PARTITION
# ======================================================================
partition = {
 "source": "synthetic tabular cohort (protected generator seed pinned)",
 "total_pool_samples": int(roster["n_samples"].sum()),
 "n_effective_samples": N_eligible,
 "n_clients_candidate": len(roster),
 "n_clients_eligible": n_eligible,
 "per_client": {r.client_id: {"site": r.site, "n_samples": int(r.n_samples),
                              "weight": float(r.n_samples / N_eligible) if r.n_samples in set(eligible["n_samples"]) else 0.0,
                              "eligible": bool(audit.loc[i, "eligible"])}
                for i, r in roster.iterrows()},
 "non_iid_structure": "natural heterogeneity (covariate + label shift), no Dirichlet re-sampling applied",
 "partition_rule": "frozen for the round; no client may add/remove samples after contract signing",
 "held_out_global_test": "central reference split, never distributed to clients",
}

# ======================================================================
# 5. PRIVACY BUDGET
# ======================================================================
eps_total, delta_total = 8.0, 1e-5
eps_round, delta_round = eps_total / rounds_T, delta_total / rounds_T
sigma_conservative = math.sqrt(2 * math.log(1.25 / delta_round)) / eps_round   # non-amplified upper bound
n_min = int(eligible["n_samples"].min())
q = batch / n_min
privacy = {
 "mechanism": "DP-SGD client-side per-example gradient clipping + Gaussian noise on client updates",
 "accountant": "RDP / PRV (production run); conservative Gaussian bound shown for audit only",
 "total_budget": {"epsilon": eps_total, "delta": delta_total},
 "round_budget": {"epsilon_round": eps_round, "delta_round": delta_round, "rounds": rounds_T},
 "sampling_rate_q": round(q, 4),
 "clip_norm_C": 1.0,
 "grad_norm_p95_cap_required": 50.0,
 "noise_multiplier_sigma_operational": 1.2,
 "noise_multiplier_sigma_conservative_upper_bound": round(sigma_conservative, 2),
 "budget_enforcement": "hard stop at eps_total; if exhausted mid-round the client is dropped, not silently re-budgeted",
 "forbidden": ["per-example raw data export", "unclipped updates", "reuse of a round budget across tasks"],
 "audit_artifact": "per-round cumulative epsilon ledger (RDP->(eps,delta) conversion) stored with the contract hash",
}

# ======================================================================
# 6. THREAT MODEL — incl. a poisoning adversary
# ======================================================================
threat_model = {
 "scope": "closed, pinned roster of eligible clients; no open enrollment, no sybil admission in this round",
 "adversaries": [
   {"id": "A1", "class": "malicious_client", "goal": "poisoning (availability/integrity)",
    "capability": "full control of ONE eligible client's local data, code and updates",
    "assumed_corruption": {"f_clients": 1, "f_fraction_of_effective": round(1 / n_eligible, 3),
                           "bound_check": f"{n_eligible} >= 2f+1 = 3  -> satisfied"},
    "attack_vectors": ["label/response flipping on up to 30% of local rows",
                       "gradient scaling gamma in [3, 10] or sign flip",
                       "backdoor trigger feature activated on poisoned rows",
                       "duplicate-inflated batch sampling"],
    "detectability": "degraded local val RMSE, update norm p95 > 50, cosine-similarity outlier vs. trimmed centroid"},
   {"id": "A2", "class": "honest-but-curious_server", "goal": "inference on client data",
    "capability": "sees all client updates and metadata",
    "mitigation": ["per-client DP noise (Section 5)", "optional secure aggregation for the summation step",
                   "no access to raw rows or per-example gradients"]},
   {"id": "A3", "class": "external_network_adversary", "goal": "tampering / replay of round messages",
    "mitigation": ["signed round manifest (contract SHA-256 in every message header)",
                   "TLS transport, monotonic round counter, reject stale round signatures"]},
 ],
 "robust_aggregation": {
   "rule": "coordinate-wise trimmed mean (beta=1) on norm-clipped updates, then DP noise, then FedAvg weights",
   "shape_check": f"n={n_eligible}, trim 1 per tail -> {n_eligible-2} contributors > f=1  -> Byzantine-robust for f=1",
   "norm_clip_before_aggregation": 1.0,
   "fallback": "Krum / geometric median if >1 client flagged by the outlier audit in the same round",
   "detection_suite": ["update cosine-similarity z-score vs. coordinate median",
                       "client loss trajectory vs. its own baseline",
                       "norm p95 and rank-1 direction drift",
                       "canary / trigger-feature probe computed server-side"],
   "response_policy": "flag -> re-run aggregation without suspect; if 2 consecutive flags -> suspend client pending review",
 },
 "residual_risk": "f=1 poisoning is tolerated but not provably neutralised under non-IID shift; DP noise adds variance, "
                  "so a poisoning-induced RMSE shift below ~1.5% may remain undetected within one round.",
 "out_of_scope": ["malicious server colluding with a client", "f >= 2 colluding clients", "raw-data membership disclosure beyond (eps,delta)"],
}

# ======================================================================
# 7. ASSEMBLE + RECORD AS AUTHORITATIVE ROUND INPUT
# ======================================================================
contract = {
 "contract_version": "1.0",
 "round_id": ROUND_ID,
 "issued_at": ISSUED_AT,
 "generator_seed": SEED,
 "status": "AUTHORITATIVE_TASK_INPUT_FOR_ROUND",
 "supersedes": None,
 "objective": objective,
 "data_partition": partition,
 "eligibility_criteria": {k: {"rule": f"{v['op']} {v['threshold']}", "field": v["field"]}
                          for k, v in criteria.items()},
 "eligibility_audit": {r.client_id: {"eligible": bool(audit.loc[i, "eligible"]),
                                     "failed_gates": audit.loc[i, "failed_gates"]}
                       for i, r in roster.iterrows()},
 "privacy_budget": privacy,
 "threat_model": threat_model,
 "signing_parties": [r.client_id for r in eligible.itertuples()],
 "change_control": "immutable for this round; any amendment requires a new round_id and a new hash",
}

canonical = json.dumps(contract, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=str)
digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()
contract["record_integrity"] = {"canonical_sha256": digest, "hash_algorithm": "SHA-256",
                                "canonicalisation": "json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))"}

out = Path(".")
(out / "federated_task_contract.json").write_text(json.dumps(contract, indent=2, default=str))
(out / "federated_task_contract.sha256").write_text(f"{digest}  federated_task_contract.json\n")
audit.to_csv(out / "client_eligibility_audit.csv", index=False)
eligible.to_csv(out / "client_roster_manifest.csv", index=False)

# ======================================================================
# 8. HUMAN-READABLE SUMMARY
# ======================================================================
print(f"ROUND {ROUND_ID}  |  status: {contract['status']}")
print("-" * 78)
print("MODEL      :", objective["model_type"])
print("OBJECTIVE  :", objective["global_objective"])
print("ROUNDS     :", objective["rounds"], "| local epochs", objective["local_epochs"], "| batch", objective["local_batch_size"])
print()
print("ELIGIBILITY AUDIT (5 candidates)")
show = audit[["client_id", "site", "n_samples", "missing_rate", "target_coverage",
              "uptime", "grad_norm_p95", "eligible", "failed_gates"]]
print(show.to_string(index=False))
print()
print(f"Effective cohort: {n_eligible}/{len(roster)} clients | N = {N_eligible:,} of {int(roster['n_samples'].sum()):,} pooled rows")
print("Excluded       :", ", ".join(f"{r.client_id} ({r.failed_gates})" for r in excluded.itertuples()))
print()
print("FedAvg AGGREGATION WEIGHTS")
print(eligible[["client_id", "n_samples", "weight"]].assign(weight=lambda d: d.weight.round(4)).to_string(index=False))
print()
print("PRIVACY    : eps_total=%.1f, delta=%.0e over T=%d rounds  ->  eps_round=%.3f, sigma(op)=%.1f"
      % (eps_total, delta_total, rounds_T, eps_round, privacy["noise_multiplier_sigma_operational"]))
print("             conservative non-amplified sigma upper bound = %.2f (audit only), q = %.4f, C = %.1f"
      % (sigma_conservative, q, privacy["clip_norm_C"]))
print()
print("THREAT MODEL")
print("  A1 malicious client  : f = 1 of %d eligible (%.0f%%), poisoning (label flip / gradient scaling / backdoor)"
      % (n_eligible, 100 * 1 / n_eligible))
print("  aggregation defence  :", threat_model["robust_aggregation"]["rule"])
print("  shape check          :", threat_model["robust_aggregation"]["shape_check"])
print("  A2 server            : honest-but-curious -> DP noise (+ optional secure aggregation)")
print()
print("RECORD INTEGRITY -> federated_task_contract.json")
print("  SHA-256:", digest)
print("  files  :", ", ".join(sorted(p.name for p in [out/'federated_task_contract.json',
        out/'federated_task_contract.sha256', out/'client_eligibility_audit.csv', out/'client_roster_manifest.csv'])))

# --- cohort plot -------------------------------------------------------
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(9, 3.6))
ax = sns.barplot(data=roster, x="client_id", y="n_samples",
                 hue=audit["eligible"].map({True: "eligible", False: "excluded"}), dodge=False,
                 palette={"eligible": "#2a6f97", "excluded": "#c1121f"})
for i, r in roster.iterrows():
    w = r.n_samples / N_eligible if audit.loc[i, "eligible"] else 0.0
    ax.text(i, r.n_samples + 250, f"w={w:.3f}" if w else "excluded", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.axhline(criteria["min_samples"]["threshold"], ls="--", c="grey")
ax.text(4.35, criteria["min_samples"]["threshold"] + 250, "min_samples gate", fontsize=8, color="grey")
ax.set(title=f"{ROUND_ID}: candidate cohort vs. eligibility (N_eff={N_eligible:,})", ylabel="samples", xlabel="client")
ax.legend(title="")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
